description: Starts a site-wide SEO crawl of up to 50 pages, in the background, for the problems one page cannot show: broken links, duplicate titles and descriptions, orphan and deep pages, noindex and sitemap mismatches and soft 404s. Use it when the person wants the whole site checked. It returns at once with jobId; call get_site_crawl with it every 20 to 30 seconds until status is done. Crawls honour robots.txt and pause between pages, so 50 pages take a few minutes. Results are kept 24 hours. These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

limit.description: The most pages to fetch, 1 to 50. Defaults to 50.

pinned.description: Up to 10 money pages (pricing, product, contact) to crawl first, as absolute URLs on the same site. Defaults to none.

url.description: Where the crawl starts, usually the home page: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: start_site_crawl
title: Start a site-wide SEO crawl
